quotes.text: Artificial intelligence is transforming every aspect of our economy and our society, as we well know.

But it is also going to have some downfalls and some things that are dangerous that we need to really guard against. [...] How should regulators think about contracting with innovators to integrate AI into the regulatory and oversight functions that we have, particularly in Congress?
How should lawmakers be thinking about integrating AI tools into HHS and CMS and FDA to create a more efficient process like quicker drug approvals?
And I am very, very concerned—I think we all are—about that.
